rules.rationale: These projects have no reachable android-13 tag or other defensible upstream baseline, and their checked-out HEAD equals the A13 root gitlink. They are therefore frozen component snapshots, not enumerable post-root branch patches. Their files remain covered by final-tree inventory and AOSP16-to-Android-16 promotion evidence; no synthetic empty-tree patch is invented.
rules.necessity: The component snapshots may be necessary build/runtime inputs, but classifying every upstream file as a BlueStacks patch would be false provenance.
rules.performance: No target cost; this is an audit-boundary decision.
rules.security: Prebuilt and custom snapshot identities must be pinned by SHA/hash and supplied through controlled sources. Lack of an upstream baseline is recorded, not hidden.
validation_evidence: All 34 entries have A13 HEAD equal to the root gitlink and no post-gitlink branch delta; the four projects whose branch heads differ from root pointers are separately enumerated as real patch histories.
